Container.Name: mc-router-ui
Container.Overview: Minecraft reverse-proxy web UI (built on itzg/mc-router) with Cloudflare DDNS, Crafty Controller integration, and Docker label discovery. mc-router and the web UI run together in a single container via supervisord.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Container Path: /data — stores the SQLite database and persistent config.

Config.Name: Crafty Servers Directory (optional)
Config.Description: Container Path: /crafty/servers — mount Crafty's servers directory here to allow port changes via server.properties.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (optional)
Config.Description: Mount the Docker socket to enable auto-discovery of routes from container labels.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Admin account username. Created on first start only.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Admin account password. CHANGE THIS. Only used to bootstrap on first start.

Config.Name: Secret Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional session secret key. Leave blank to auto-generate and persist one.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token (optional)
Config.Description: Cloudflare API token with DNS:Edit permission for automatic DNS records and DDNS.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone ID (optional)
Config.Description: Cloudflare Zone ID. Alternative to Zone Name below.

Config.Name: DDNS Interval
Config.Description: How often (seconds) to check for public IP changes and update DNS.

Config.Name: Crafty URL (optional)
Config.Description: Crafty Controller base URL, e.g. https://192.168.1.50:8443.

Config.Name: Crafty Insecure Skip Verify (optional)
Config.Description: Set to "true" to skip TLS verification for self-signed Crafty certificates.

Config.Name: Crafty Servers Dir (optional)
Config.Description: Path inside container to Crafty's servers directory.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Internal mc-router REST API port. Internal only.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Map this port to access the web UI.

Config.Name: Minecraft Game Port
Config.Description: Minecraft server port — must match the port forwarding in your router.
